title: This Country Is Wider Than the Moon #didyouknow #facts
description:
Australia is almost 4,000 km wide from east to west. The Moon is about 3,475 km across, Pluto about 2,380 km. But the Moon's surface is still about five times bigger than Australia.

Which country should we check next? Drop your flag in the comments.
